title: SrcBox voice pack manifest
description: What the update check reads first. It is published as the voice-pack release asset and is also readable from the repository itself.

packs.description: One entry per language. The app picks the entry for its own language and falls back to the first entry when there is none.

version.description: Must match the version inside the pack and the voice-pack-<version> release the pack is attached to.

url.description: Where the pack is downloaded from; the release asset is tried first.

path.description: Path inside the repository, used when the release asset is unreachable (jsDelivr) and by the consistency tests.
